title: Sink or pipe leak
blurb: Dripping, slow drains or damp cabinets

required_shots.tip: Include the counter, faucet and cabinet.

required_shots.prompt: Open the cabinet and look underneath
required_shots.tip: Use your phone light if it's dark under there.

required_shots.prompt: Get close to where it's leaking
required_shots.tip: Focus on the drip, stain or wet spot.

required_shots.prompt: Can you see the shut-off valves?
required_shots.tip: They're usually on the pipes on the wall.

questions.q: Have you turned the water off?
Any damage to the cabinet or floor?

notes_prompt: Anything else a pro should know?
